ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution; approximately 0.8:1 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral fluke area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Distinct high-intensity (white) contiguous regions occupy the distal 50-60% of both lobes; low-intensity (black) regions dominate the central peduncle area and the proximal margins of the fluke; high-frequency transition mottling (speckled black-on-white) exists at the inner-boundary of the white fields.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central notch; internal angle calculated at approximately 28 degrees with a depth of roughly 12% of the vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations along the full trailing edge; amplitudes range from 2 to 12 pixels; notable concentration of larger-amplitude notches and peaks on the distal outer margins.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Overall symmetrical upward-curving trajectory from the notch to the tips; the trailing edge boundary exhibits a broadly convex curve.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple localized, roughly circular low-intensity (black) pixel clusters detected on the white distal regions, primarily concentrated on the mid-outer section of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Subtle diagonal linear pixel disruptions (rake-like marks) visible on the high-intensity field of the right lobe distal section.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Jagged structural irregularity and fragmentation visible on the extreme outer tips, with more pronounced erosion on the right lobe distal point.
other_distinctive_markers: Lower proximal boundary of the fluke and peduncle junction are occluded by high-intensity, high-frequency pixel clusters representing water spray.
